newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Singapore's Pidemco Land Ltd sets US$120 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: Singapore's Pidemco Land Ltd sets US$120 mln FRN.

text.p: Pidemco Land Ltd's US$120
million floating rate note is in general syndication, bankers
said.
